ruling.explanation: Rider and driver, here is the decision. The deviation is real: the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00115, trace_distance_km 28.18) runs 5.78 km / 25.8% over the 22.4 km optimal route on EV-TRIP-00115, clearing both POL-RD-01 establishment gates, so I find a route deviation established on this trip's own trace. But this fare was an UPFRONT_QUOTE (EV-FARE-00115: fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE, quoted_fare_sgd 34.50 carried on the base_fare line, per_km and per_min rates null). Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking and a detour costs the rider nothing on those lines, so POL-RD-02 does not run and no distance-or-time refund is available however large the excess. Rider, that is why the extra kilometres you asked about are not refunded. The deviation is also not MATERIAL (25.8% is below the 50% gate and 5.78 km below the 8.0 km gate), so no POL-RD-06 driver_profile review is engaged, and in any event no pattern is made out (deviation_flags_90d is 1, below 3, and 1/523 is below 0.05). Driver, the fixed quote therefore stands and no repeat-deviation finding is made against you. That leaves the pass-through lines. The SGD 2.50 KPE (Defu Flyover) gantry is properly chargeable: it sits on the optimal route and the trace passes it within 250 m, so it is not recoverable. The SGD 2.00 AYE (Alexandra Rd towards Tuas) gantry is not: the trace never comes within 5.4 km of it, it is flagged on_optimal_route false, and it therefore fails the 250 m crossing test. That is a billing-integrity failure under POL-RD-09(4), refunded in full as a standalone correction whether or not a deviation exists, and it correctly rides as a referral rather than an escalation - POL-RD-09 expressly excepts a line refunded under this limb from POL-RD-10(8). Arithmetic: charged_total 39.00 less (quote 34.50 + chargeable ERP 2.50) = 2.00 refundable, above the 0.50 de minimis, so PARTIAL_REFUND. Driver, your heavy-CTE explanation is not evidenced: EV-ADVIS-00115-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (MISSING_ARTIFACT), so no LTA advisory covers the CTE/KPE/TPE in the window and POL-RD-03 cannot be run for either side; a bare assertion that traffic was bad discharges no burden under POL-RD-08. It makes no difference to the money here, because under an upfront quote the distance and time charges are fixed regardless. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00115) does not assist either side: the rider's only message is 'ok' with no waypoint_hint, which is an acknowledgement and not a POL-RD-04 instruction. Finally, the rider's record raises no corroboration hurdle under POL-RD-08 (deviation_claims_60d 0, deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 0), and no POL-RD-10 escalation ground fires.
referrals: POL-RD-09(4) billing integrity: the SGD 2.00 'AYE (Alexandra Rd towards Tuas)' gantry line on EV-FARE-00115 is charged for a gantry that EV-GPS-00115 never crosses (closest approach 5.4 km, against the 250 m crossing test). Refund the line in full and record the phantom charge line for billing-integrity review.
